pages.quiz:
HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about National integration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain National integration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say National integration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat National integration as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing National integration.

2. Which statement about Introduction to History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Introduction to History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Introduction to History and Citizenship.
   C. Explain Introduction to History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Introduction to History and Citizenship as rumours only.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

4. Which statement about Elections in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Elections in Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elections in Kenya.
   C. Explain Elections in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Elections in Kenya never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Modern Nationalism in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Modern Nationalism in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Modern Nationalism in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Modern Nationalism in Africa.
   D. Explain Modern Nationalism in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Name the president
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Measure rainfall only

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

8. Which statement about Colonization of Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonization of Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Colonization of Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Colonization of Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Colonization of Africa.

9. Which statement about African Civilisations up to 19th Century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say African Civilisations up to 19th Century never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations up to 19th Century.
   C. Treat African Civilisations up to 19th Century as rumours only.
   D. Explain African Civilisations up to 19th Century with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Establishment of colonial rule is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Establishment of colonial rule never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Establishment of colonial rule with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Establishment of colonial rule as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Establishment of colonial rule.

11. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

12. Which statement about Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence.
   C. Say Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Political and Constitutional developments and challenges since Independence as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain International organisations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Modern slavery and servitude Page 15 of 75 xiii 3.4 Global governance 3.5 1st Ge and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Modern Slavery and Servitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Global governance 3.5 1st Generation of industrial revolution in Europe and Afri and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
